label: D1 fixation during a sustained run of a2 choices, early-to-mid episode
explanation: Update-gate unit z12 is active almost only at D1 (94% of mass; weak tail at GO, never at D2) when the agent is in a stretch of repeated a2 choices: it never fires when any of the previous 3 trials chose a1 or when the upcoming choice is a1 (action==2 holds for 100% of the mass). The only FUTURE variable is action at D1, which is the agent own upcoming choice (legitimate); the observed version, prev_action==2 within a run of a2, says nearly the same thing because the unit only fires inside a2 runs. It is strongly episode-time dependent: rate peaks at trials 10-19 and falls to zero after about trial 60, and it is absent on trials 0-2. Magnitude: higher when the D1 reward input is 1 (71% of mass), and largest on the first rewarded D1 after a few unrewarded or rare a2 trials, then decays over consecutive rewarded a2 trials (1.0 -> 0.57 -> 0.39 in top windows). It falls in the moderate a2-preference logit band (choice -4.4 to -1.5) and mid value band. Precision is only about 0.5 because many D1 steps inside a2 runs stay inactive, so the gate is better read as a graded a2-run / early-episode signal than a crisp detector.
